discovery_candidates.name: gaseous-server
discovery_candidates.description: A game ROM manager, with a built in web based emulator.

install_startup.recipe: native (no compose/Docker recipe in this repo; a Dockerfile exists at build/Dockerfile but this session's container cannot pull the mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 base image -- confirmed against both Docker Hub and ghcr.io, both fail identically at the CDN blob-download stage with 403 Forbidden)
install_startup.recipe_modification_note: The automated pipeline's 'no Dockerfile or compose file' finding was about the acquisition pipeline's own container-recipe detection, not the actual repo -- a real Dockerfile (build/Dockerfile) and docker-compose-build.yml do exist. Docker wasn't usable here regardless (image pulls blocked), so verified natively instead: .NET SDK 10.0.112 (matching the Dockerfile's own mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0) installed via Ubuntu's own apt archive (dotnet-sdk-10.0 package), native MariaDB (already running on this shelf), ffmpeg via apt. One real build fix needed, disclosed in README.md: this apt-packaged SDK's linux-x64 FrameworkReference resolution doesn't expose Microsoft.AspNetCore.Server.IIS's reference assembly for compilation even though it is physically present in the installed Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Ref pack; since this app only ever runs under Kestrel on Linux (IIS is Windows-only, and the equivalent Kestrel option is configured right next to it in the same file), the four-line IISServerOptions.Configure block in Program.cs was removed rather than fighting the reference-resolution gap further. The EmulatorJS submodule (the in-browser emulation UI) clones fine from GitHub, but its own emulator core binaries are fetched separately from cdn.emulatorjs.org, which this sandbox's egress policy blocks (confirmed: 403) -- the 'Play in browser' feature specifically is therefore unverified; core library/account/settings management is not affected.
install_startup.startup_command: dbhost=127.0.0.1 dbuser=gaseous dbpass=gaseous dotnet run --project gaseous-server/gaseous-server.csproj -c Release -r linux-x64 --no-self-contained
